heroSubtitle: Ambient documentation is the highest-impact AI tool in healthcare today — when it's used well. We support the full lifecycle: vendor selection, provider training, go-live support, and note-quality optimization for Nuance DAX and Sunoh.ai by eClinicalWorks.

lifecycle.title: The Full Ambient
lifecycle.subtitle: Most vendors hand you a license and a help doc. We cover everything in between.

items.title: Selection & Planning
items.description: Independent evaluation of ambient vendors against your EHR, specialties, and budget — plus rollout planning that sets realistic expectations.

items.title: Provider Training
items.description: Hands-on onboarding that teaches providers how to work with the tool — encounter flow, note review, and specialty-specific techniques.

items.title: Go-Live Support
items.description: Elbow-to-elbow support during launch, on site or on screen, so adoption starts strong instead of stalling in week one.

items.title: Optimization
items.description: Note-quality review, workflow tuning, and usage analysis that keep documentation quality and provider satisfaction climbing after go-live.

items.name: Nuance DAX
items.description: Ambient clinical documentation that listens to patient encounters and generates clinical notes automatically. We train providers on workflow integration, note review, and optimization for maximum documentation quality.

items.name: Sunoh.ai / eCW
items.description: Ambient documentation built into the eClinicalWorks EHR. We help your providers adopt Sunoh.ai and integrate it into their existing eCW workflows for seamless documentation.

formats.title: Training
formats.subtitle: Training designed around your go-live timeline.

items.title: Webinars
items.description: Introductory sessions that build awareness and set expectations before your rollout.

items.title: Virtual Workshops
items.description: Remote hands-on training for providers, walking through real encounter scenarios with the tool.

items.title: In-Person Workshops
items.description: On-site, elbow-to-elbow training during go-live. The most effective format for clinical adoption.

items.title: Coaching
items.description: Post-go-live coaching that reinforces best practices and drives sustained adoption across your provider teams.

ctaTitle: Planning — or Rescuing — an Ambient Rollout?
ctaSubtitle: Whether you're selecting a vendor, preparing for go-live, or trying to fix low adoption, let's talk.
